     Thought · 13.3s

     Two ways to shape the docs index — asking before I pick one.

     → Asked 1 question

     ▣  Build · Muse Spark 1.3 Free

  ┃
  ┃  The docs index can be grouped two ways and the choice is not reversible cheaply. Which grouping should it ship with?
  ┃
  ┃  1. Group by task (Recommended)
  ┃     One heading per thing a reader is trying to do, with the pages that serve it listed under it
  ┃  2. Group by component
  ┃     One heading per package, mirroring the internal/ tree, so a page's home is mechanical
  ┃  3. Flat list, no grouping
  ┃     Leave every page at the top level and let the reader's search do the grouping
  ┃  4. Type your own answer
